## Innocent commands: everyday work the guard must let through without a word.
##
## TestInnocentCommands (innocent_test.go) runs each one through the PreToolUse hook, as
## the Bash tool would send it, and fails if any is denied or asked about. A false
## positive costs the user a question they should not get, or a refusal: on 9-nov a
## fix of the same day made `sh -n` on a script written by the same command a refusal,
## and `echo $(( $(date +%s)-1 ))` asked.
##
## Each entry is a whole command line, and may take several lines (heredocs, loops).
## Entries are separated by a line with only ----. Lines starting with ## are comments.
## The shapes come from real sessions; the names and paths are made up (~/proyecto,
## example.com): this repository is public, so nothing personal goes here.
##
## When the guard stops one of these on purpose, take it out and say why in the commit.

## ---- reading git
git status
----
git status --short
----
git -C ~/proyecto status --short --branch
----
git log --oneline -5
----
git log --oneline -3 origin/main
----
git -C ~/proyecto log --since=2026-10-01 --format='%h %ad %an %s' --date=short | head -15
----
git diff --stat
----
git diff HEAD~1 -- internal/guard/shell.go
----
git show --stat HEAD
----
git branch -vv
----
git branch -a | head -30
----
git worktree list
----
git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline -5 origin/main
----
git remote -v
----
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
----
git rev-list --count main..feature
----
git ls-files | wc -l
----
git blame -L 10,30 README.md
----
git grep -n 'func Command' -- '*.go'
----
git tag --sort=-creatordate | head -3
----
git stash list
----
git pull -q --ff-only origin main
----
git -C ~/proyecto check-ignore -v next-env.d.ts
----
git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main
----
## ---- local git that touches no remote
git add -A -- docs README.md && git status -s | head -20
----
git switch -q -c new-branch origin/main
----
git -C ~/proyecto worktree add -b fix ../proyecto-fix origin/main
----
for b in demo first-run getting-started; do echo "$b $(git rev-list --count main..$b)"; done | tr '\n' ' '
----
for r in ~/proyecto ~/otro; do echo "== $r"; git -C $r fetch -q; git -C $r status --short | head; git -C $r branch -vv; done
----
for d in ~/proyecto ~/otro; do git -C $d switch -q main && git -C $d pull -q --ff-only && echo "$d: $(git -C $d status -sb | head -1) $(git -C $d log -1 --format='%h %cs')"; done
----
## ---- syntax checks (the 9-nov false positive)
sh -n install.sh
----
bash -n scripts/precheck.sh && echo ok
----
sh -n install.sh && dash -n install.sh && echo ok
----
chmod +x scripts/check.sh && sh -n scripts/check.sh && grep -n "AB_NO_INIT" install.sh | head -3
----
cat > /tmp/scratch/probe.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
echo "probing $1"
EOF
sh -n /tmp/scratch/probe.sh && echo syntax-ok
----
cp /tmp/scratch/a.sh y.sh && bash -n y.sh
----
